facts.text: John and his wife had their first dance at a cozy restaurant with candlelight and music.

evidence.quote: We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight.
Having everyone there made it extra special.

facts.text: John expressed gratitude for Tim's presence and the love and joy Tim brings to his life.

evidence.quote: Your words mean a lot. I'm lucky to have you in my life, bringing so much love and joy.

facts.text: Tim shared a photo of a bookcase filled with his favorite fantasy novels and DVDs.

evidence.quote: I also wanted to share this bookshelf with you. It's filled with my favorite fantasy novels.
